items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: Thompson McKay, there were two brothers, Percy and Thompson. Percy is one of the vice presidents of the Whitney Bank. Thompson's a consulting engineer in Dallas... He was better than Percy

ctx.x: And it just messed me up. I couldn't get that stroke. Now, Thompson McKay, there were two brothers, Percy and Thompson. Percy is one of the vice presidents of the Whitney Bank. Thompson's a consulting engineer in Dallas for one of the very big engineering firms. He was better than Percy and he had that Negro style down pat. He played just exactly like they did in the cornfield plantation stuff. Now, the best guitarist that I ever heard any place, and I don't think there'll ever be one before or after, no matter…
You can hear that on those records that Johnny had him to record. Yes, indeed. Did he do much better than that? Those are plenty good.
